short_description: Reset my account password
description: I forgot my password and the reset link on the portal does not work. Please reset the password on my account. You can reach me on 617-555-0142.

short_description: Access cards for the new graduates
description: Please assign access cards to the three graduates who start on Wednesday. They need building access from the first day.

short_description: Add user to the Confluence team space
description: Please give Maria Lopez access to our team space in Confluence. She joined the project this week and cannot open any of the pages.

short_description: My software licence has expired
description: The licence for the design tool on my account expired and now I cannot open it. Please assign a new licence to my user.

short_description: Create an account for a contractor
description: We need a user account for a contractor who starts on Monday, with access to the team site. Write to j.alvarez@example.com if you need her details.

short_description: Windows upgrade fails halfway
description: The Windows upgrade from software center stops with an error at about 60 percent. I have tried it twice and it fails the same way each time.

short_description: Outlook crashes after the latest update
description: Since the update on Monday Outlook closes by itself a few seconds after it opens. I get an error about the version when I restart it.

short_description: Please install the analysis software
description: I need the latest version of the data analysis software on my laptop. When I try to install it myself I get an installation error.

short_description: Reporting tool shows an error after the upgrade
description: After the upgrade last week the reporting tool gives an error and won't open any reports. The old version worked fine.

short_description: Software center installation is stuck
description: The installation of the VPN client has been stuck on pending in software center since yesterday. It never starts.

short_description: New starter form for Priya
description: Please process the new starter form for Priya, who joins on Monday. HR has attached the signed form and she needs the usual system access for her role.

short_description: Error when submitting my time card
description: When I submit my time card for approval I get an error message. The deadline for this week is today, please help.

short_description: Leave request form will not submit
description: I am trying to submit my leave request for next month but the form shows an error after I press submit. My manager is waiting for it.

short_description: Access to Oracle Fusion for my new role
description: I have taken over the payroll officer role from Tom and need the same access in Oracle Fusion that he had. HR approved the move.

short_description: Employee leaving, HR form attached
description: One of my analysts leaves at the end of the month. The leaver form from HR is attached, please arrange what is needed on the system side.

short_description: Monitor on my desk has no signal
description: The second monitor at my desk shows no signal since this morning. I checked the cable at both ends and tried another port on the laptop.

short_description: Laptop battery does not last
description: My laptop battery drains within an hour even when I am only reading mail. I need a new battery or a replacement laptop.

short_description: Printer on floor 3 is not printing
description: The printer on floor 3 near the kitchen is not printing and shows an error on the display. Nobody on the floor can print.

short_description: Cable missing in the meeting room
description: The HDMI cable in meeting room Atlas is gone and we have a client presentation this afternoon. Please send a cable and check the other equipment.

short_description: Phone handset not working
description: The desk phone has no dial tone since the move to the new desk. The number needs to be reassigned to the new socket.

short_description: Please create a new project code
description: We need a new project code for the migration project. The contract is pending signature but the team starts tomorrow. The form is attached.

short_description: Project code not in the timesheet
description: The new project code was created last week but I cannot find it when I fill in my timesheet. Please add the code so my team can book time.

short_description: Set up the pipeline for the new project
description: Please set up the build pipeline for the new internal project and add the project code to it. The team lead will provide the repository details.

short_description: Forecast view rights for the project code
description: I need rights to view and enter the forecast for project code 40517 now that I am the project lead. Please add me.

short_description: Project codes for the new order
description: A formal order has been received for the client. Please create the project codes for the three work packages and set the start date to the first of the month.

short_description: Add me to the distribution list
description: Please add me to the finance team distribution list. I moved to the team last week and I am missing all the group mails.

short_description: Approval request is pending and stuck
description: My change request has been pending approval for a week. The approver says they never got the notification. Can you check why it is stuck?

short_description: Change the owner of the group
description: The owner of our shared group left the company. Please change the owner to me so I can approve new members.

short_description: Please approve the change
description: Please approve and perform the attached change. The change was approved by the manager on Thursday but has not been done yet.

short_description: Update the manager on my record
description: My line manager changed last month but the system still shows the old one. Please update it so approvals go to the right person.

short_description: Purchase order for new keyboards
description: Please raise a purchase order for five keyboards for the new starters. The quote is attached and the budget holder has approved it.

short_description: Purchased a charger, please log it
description: I purchased a replacement charger for my laptop. The receipt is attached. Please log the purchase and the installation.

short_description: PO number needed for supplier invoice
description: The supplier says they need our PO number before they release the invoice for the ordered monitors. Can you find the number?

short_description: Goods received against the order
description: The ordered items arrived today and the delivery note is attached. Please book the receipt against the purchase order.

short_description: Order a cooling fan for the rack
description: We need a new cooling fan for the server rack. Please place the order and send me the purchase order number when you have it.

short_description: Delegate access to the shared mailbox
description: Please give Sam delegate access to the shared mailbox for the support team, with permission to send on behalf of the team.

short_description: My mailbox is full
description: My mailbox has hit its size limit and I cannot receive new mail. Please increase the mailbox size, I need the old messages for an audit.

short_description: Permissions on the shared folder
description: The new team member cannot open the shared folder for the planning documents. Please add the right permissions for him.

short_description: Need more space for the team folder
description: Our shared team folder is nearly full and people cannot save files. Please increase the size of the share.

short_description: Access request for the reviewers
description: Please give the three reviewers read access to the audit folder on the share. The list of names is attached to the ticket.
